preconditions.description: The input 'results' must be a string.

postconditions.description: If the input 'results' is an empty string, the output must also be an empty string.
The output must contain exactly three parts: Range, Average, and Median.

postconditions.expression: all(part.startswith('Range: ') or part.startswith('Average: ') or part.startswith('Median: ') for part in return_value.split())
postconditions.description: Each part of the output must start with 'Range: ', 'Average: ', or 'Median: '.
Each time in the output must be in the format 'hh|mm|ss'.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= int(part) < 100 for part in time.split('|')) for time in return_value.replace('Range: ', '').replace('Average: ', '').replace('Median: ', '').split())
postconditions.description: Each part of the time in the output must be a two-digit integer between 00 and 99.
